race.comment: CLUBMAN (5) has taken his time to warm into the prep but was good last time when beaten a long neck despite being an outside chance in the betting. The rise in trip looks the key and he's ready to put it all together. OLD FAITHFUL (1) is the main danger with proven 2200m form. Was a forgivable fourth last start after beginning slowly and being bumped. AMELIORATION (4) brings winning form after beating EVADE THE GAME in a CL1 here last time and has already placed at the trip, so she has to be treated as a live winning chance again. EVADE THE GAME (6) chased AMELIORATION home last time and gets weight relief. Gets her first look at this trip but her splits suggest she will run it.
